metadata.title: Verifying Private AI Valuations
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Portuguese (short form). HAI persona takes only the shortest cues (Hi · Ola · Hej · Ciao) per the ai-explainer word budget. Wagwan mod-10 rule is Bear-only and does not apply.
metadata.color_semantics: Claude FIDELITY skin: cream #F2F0E9 stage, warm ink #3D3929, terracotta #D97757 as the ONE accent — one terracotta moment per beat. The source Mycroft figures used crimson #C8102E as the data series and ochre #C8860E for annotation; both are remapped to the Claude accent grammar (terracotta = the data series and the single focal moment, ink = structure, muted ink = de-emphasis). This is a palette change, not a data change.
metadata.derived_from: Rebuild of the 6-beat static cut built 2026-08-08 by the Mycroft repo's own tool (archived at _previous-build/). Narration source: narration_script.md (human-authored). Same facts, same numbers, all 20 FACTCHECK rows confirmed — restructured onto the brutalist.art ai-explainer spine and re-shot so every claim beat MOVES.
metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B07 (verdict artifact), B08 (handoff) and B09 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The three source PNGs in pantry/ are REFERENCE for the rebuild, never slotted as media. LOGO LAW: no HAI logo file ships in runtime/remotion/src/logos/, so the channel handle renders as a clean serif wordmark bug (lower-right, inside SAFE) on every body beat — per the law's explicit fallback.
metadata.topic_note: Slot-1 kicker is the FIXED claude-hai series name (runtime/qc/brand_labels.json, GATE L rule 7) — not a per-video guess. The project identifier lives in the segment title and the description instead. The fit is real, not just compliance: the episode is a human hand-checking numbers a pipeline would have gotten wrong.
